profile.headline: Senior Software Development Engineer at Amazon Leo
profile.summary: Software Developer for Project Kuiper at Amazon.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer II
positions.description:
Mission Planning and Control Software for Project Kuiper:

* Designed and implemented AWS based service for provisioning AWS IOT "things" for MQTT communications - Integrated with simulated satellite platform to support initial e2e testing efforts

* Contributed to backend AWS services for Kuiper-device command scheduling and distribution, including an Approvals in-the-loop component to gate distribution and execution of mission critical commands.
 
* Designed and implemented Retool-based frontend solution that provides dynamic consoles and UIs for interacting with the Kuiper constellation and assist in mission-control objectives, adopted widely across the Kuiper program.

* Contributed to the development of backend AWS services that aid in the automation of nominal and off-nominal constellation operations (CONOPs), including progression of Kuiper-device lifecycle states and automated execution of operational procedures.

* Contributed to the operational excellence and security reviews of critical backend software services.

* Participated in satellite operations of the Project Kuiper Protoflight satellites.

* Participated in on-call rotation for supporting internal Kuiper customers.

positions.title: Graduate Lab Assistant
positions.description:
•	Instruct three undergraduate physics labs per semester
•	Assist in assembling and resetting physics lab experiments
•	Provide feedback and grades on lab assignments and reports

positions.title: Student Research Intern
positions.description:
•	Core flight software for mission critical UAVs
•	Playback tool of battery discharge and ardupilot message data
•	Python binary message parsing and data visualization tool
•	Flask-based, RESTful microservice supplying business-process data for battery utilization
•	Flask-based authentication service with user sessions, JWT, and permission management
•	Master's Thesis research on SiK radio authentication using RF fingerprinting and machine learning

positions.title: Student Technical Assistant
positions.description:
•	Assisted with weekly engineering department professional presentations
•	Managed local and remote Sequel Pro database of weekly events and student attendees
•	Developed frontend and backend attendance application using HTML CSS, JavaScript, Python Flask microframework

positions.title: Summer Games Intern
positions.description:
•	Collaborated with interns to build a supplemental gamified cyber training tool
•	Backend and frontend development using HTML CSS, Python Flask microframework
•	Game development with Unity WebGL

positions.title: College Technical Intern
positions.description:
•	Subcontracted for ENSCO Inc. to create python script for automating biometric technologies
•	Constructed Perl script to generate sample IXM transactions for Biointel Risk-based Analytics for Identity Dominance (BRAID) Independent Research and Design project for the NG annual TechFest 
•	Assisted BRAID IRAD network engineer in moving local BRAID technologies to AWS
•	Hardened Red Hat Enterprise Linux AWS image to be compliant with DoD STIG
•	Developed IP labeling, python script for NG proprietary software

positions.title: Chantilly Academy Summer Cyber-Security Assistant
positions.description: Assistant instructor at Chantilly's annual summer cyber-security camp in preparation for the Air Force Association's CyberPatriot competition. I helped instruct students in basic Windows and Linux security practices and policies, and led a demonstration on Windows batch scripting and its application in regards to cyber-security.

positions.title: Level 1 Ice Hockey Referee
positions.description: USA Hockey Level 1 Referee. Primarily responsible for officiating games for ages 13 and below.

organizations.name: Eta Kappa Nu
organizations.description: Founded in 1904, Eta Kappa Nu (HKN) is an internationally recognized Honor Society of Electrical and Computer Engineers with well over 200 chapters and 200,000 members worldwide.
